title.narrative: Strengthening basic nutritional intervention in the service of child health in order to reduce the mortality rate in a sustainable manner

description.narrative: 1- Rehabilitation of the residence wards to ensure the quality and safety of the pediatric unit in the selected facilities. 2- Providing life-saving medical equipment to revive critical cases. 3- Updating the performance of health workers in cooperation with the Ministry of Health and Population in Yemen in various fields and in the field of health care for malnutrition and infant and child care practices. 4- Purchasing essential medicines to support the provision of health and nutritional services for children. 5- Activating the monitoring and follow-up processes for the implementation of programs by the planning unit of the World Health Organization.
Reducing and reducing the mortality rate for children under the age of five by enhancing access to health and nutrition services for them.

Reducing under-five mortality by providing basic services, enhancing nutrition intervention through life-saving preventive actions, providing them with essential medical services, supporting medical and non-medical supplies and capacity building sessions Project goals
